paper.title_en: Small-$b$ expansion of the DOZZ formula for light operators
paper.abstract_en: We present a systematic asymptotic small-$b$ expansion of the Liouville DOZZ three-point structure constant in the light-operator regime $α_i=bσ_i$ in the limit $b\to0$. In this limit, the DOZZ structure constant admits the asymptotic representation \[ C(bσ_1,bσ_2,bσ_3) \sim {\cal P}(b;σ_i) \left[ 1+\sum_{n\ge1}b^{2n}Ω_n(σ_1,σ_2,σ_3) \right], \qquad b\to0 , \] where ${\cal P}(b;σ_i)$ is an explicitly determined prefactor. Using Thorn's asymptotic expansion of the $Υ_b$-function, we derive explicit closed-form expressions for the first coefficients $Ω_n(σ_i)$ and show that they form a symmetric polynomial structure in the variables $σ_i$. The resulting asymptotic expansion provides explicit finite-$b$ corrections to the leading light-limit Liouville three-point data and furnishes a practical framework for applications in celestial holography. In particular, it provides Liouville data relevant for a perturbative program aimed at studying finite-$b$ corrections to celestial Yang-Mills amplitudes. Finally, we formulate such a perturbative Liouville framework and discuss several directions for its future development.
